case: Dag Hammarskjöld plane crash (Ndola, Northern Rhodesia, September 18, 1961)
angle: The UN Secretary-General's DC-6 crashed on approach to an African airstrip with no distress call and one survivor who died days later; a 2019 UN report found 'significant new information' pointing to external attack, reopening a death the West labeled an accident for 58 years.
